'''Darrst''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Voss]], where he asked an Imperial to destroy the evidence of the Voss interactions with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the past.
